newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs seen volatile on options, Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs seen volatile on options, Wall Street.

text.p: Brazil shares are seen volatile Thursday in continued lighter-than-average volume as speculative trades ahead of Monday's options settlement and Wall Street keep weighing on the bolsa, brokers said.
"The market will continue subject to high volalitily ahead of Monday's options expiry and tracking Wall Street stock and bond prices," said a trader at a local brokerage house.
On Wednesday, local shares managed to end higher after seesawing throughout the session amid volatility due to futures index expiration and fluctuations in the U.S. stock market.
Brokers said a lack of domestic market-moving news is contributing to maintaining the local bolsa ties to stock and bond movement in New York.
They also said trading should continue limited as major players and foreign investors are likely to remain sidelined awaiting the options settlement.
